description: This file defines the UUIDAccessTokenGenerationService class which implements token generation using UUIDs, providing a method for generating random tokens by creating UUIDs without hyphens.

classes.name: UUIDAccessTokenGenerationService
classes.description: A service class that generates access tokens as UUID strings without hyphens, implementing the AccessTokenGenerationService interface.

methods.name: generateRandomToken
methods.description: Generates a random token by creating a UUID, converting it to string, and removing hyphens.
